title: Application of certain sections relating to elections

127. Application of certain sections relating to elections.—

—   The provisions of 
sections 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 , 21, 22, 23, 24, and 25 shall apply,   mutatis mutandis,   in 
respect of election of Zilla Panchayat, the deposit as security for costs being two thousand 
rupees.
